s.note: he eats them cold straight out of the tin
s.how: Warm 2 drained tins cannellini beans in 3 tbsp olive oil with 2 sliced garlic cloves, rosemary and chilli flakes, crushing a few. Pile onto grilled sourdough. Put one cold tin of baked beans and a spoon on the side for authenticity.

s.note: the Comedian's badge, with one drop of red
s.how: Beat 150g butter with 50g icing sugar, mix in 225g flour and roll 5mm thick. Cut 16 rounds and bake at 160C for 15 minutes. Ice yellow with 150g icing sugar, water and food colouring, pipe two dots and a smile, and add one drop of raspberry jam at the edge.

m.note: the Indian diner Rorschach goes to
m.how: Soften 1 onion with 2 tbsp grated ginger and 3 garlic cloves. Add 2 tsp garam masala and a tin of tomatoes, then 1kg diced chicken thighs, and simmer 30 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream. Serve with 300g basmati rice and naan.

w.note: yellow icing, one drop of red jam
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Roll to 5mm, cut rounds and bake at 180C for 9 minutes. Ice yellow with 300g icing sugar, pipe two eyes and a smile in black and add a drop of strawberry jam.

d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water in a drip machine. Pour into big mugs with milk. Drink it at the kitchen table without talking about the old days.
